tasks.title: Settings repository layer
tasks.description: Create SettingsRepository: getProfile, getWorkspaceInfo, getWorkspaces, switchWorkspace (returns new token), logout (clears secure store).
acceptanceCriteria: getProfile returns { firstName, lastName, email, avatarUrl } with defaults for missing
getWorkspaces returns array sorted by lastVisit descending
logout clears expo-secure-store token and never throws

tasks.title: Settings Zustand store
tasks.description: Create useSettingsStore: theme (dark/light/system), appVersion. Persist theme to AsyncStorage. Apply via Appearance.setColorScheme. Default dark.
acceptanceCriteria: setTheme('light') persists and app restarts in light mode
Default is 'dark' when no persisted preference

tasks.title: Settings TanStack Query hooks
tasks.description: Query: useProfile (staleTime 5min), useWorkspaces (staleTime 60s). Mutation: useSwitchWorkspace calls selectWorkspace() for new token, updates workspace Zustand store (all 4 keys), disconnects+reconnects API client, clears query cache, navigates to /(app)/tracker. Logout hook from auth phase.
acceptanceCriteria: useSwitchWorkspace updates workspace store (4 keys), clears cache, reconnects client, navigates to /(app)/tracker
After switch, connection store client points to new workspace endpoint

tasks.title: Settings route group
tasks.description: Create settings/ route group with Stack navigator. Tab entry already exists from tracker phase.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings tab shows gear icon labeled Settings
Tab is rightmost in tab bar

tasks.title: Settings main screen
tasks.description: Sections: Profile header (avatar, name, email), Workspace (name, switch row), Appearance (theme segmented control), Account (logout button calls useLogout from @/hooks/use-auth created in auth phase -- no new logout implementation needed), App info footer (version).
acceptanceCriteria: Profile header shows avatar with initials fallback, name, email
Theme toggle immediately changes app appearance
Logout shows confirmation alert; cancel does nothing

tasks.title: Workspace switcher screen
tasks.description: Workspace list from useWorkspaces. Current workspace indicator. Tap to switch with confirmation. Loading overlay. Error handling for archived/unavailable workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Current workspace has checkmark; tapping does nothing
Archived workspace shows error alert and stays on current
